title: 第5章 吞劫第6章 我要成亲了
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
“劫者，天地之怒，众生之厄，大道之试也。”
“世人避劫如避死，我视劫为食粮。”
“张口吞之，入腹化之，劫力归我，劫意归无。”
“吞一劫，长一智；吞万劫，证吾道。劫不尽，吾不灭……”
和铃抓了抓头发，一脸的震撼惊讶之色。
这是一部……功法？
她脑海里面怎么忽然多了一部功法！
“小易，狗子，你们两个有没有偷偷给我传输什么不该有的东西？”
狗系统立马道：【没有，我现在老实着呢！】
小易试探地问道：【阿铃，你说的东西是什么？你要是相信我的话，可以说给我听，小易可以帮你分析的。】
说实话，这俩系统和铃一个都不信。
“算了，你们两个保持静音吧，我自己琢磨琢磨。”
和铃重新默读了这一段功法总纲，内心表示怀疑。
吞劫？
这么能吹，到底是不是真的。
要是真的话，那也太霸道，太强势，太嚣张了吧！
不过，却很符合她的风格。
一个艰难的选择摆在了和铃的面前。
这《吞劫》她是练呢还是不练呢？
功法总纲写得这么嚣张跋扈，一看就有点邪啊！

偏偏这功法是自己出现在她脑海里面的，她也不能问人。
算了，刚来这个世界，她还是低调点，先继续练着原身修炼的《两仪分水决》吧。
左右闲着也是无事，和铃就照着原身的记忆修炼起来了。
一个时辰过去。
两个时辰过去。
半点成效也无。
【叮——今日舔狗任务已发布：对目标对象夜弦嘘寒问暖。】
【奖励：稳固金丹，修为+1。】
和铃有些炸毛：“我正修炼呢，你在这儿发任务，不是捣乱吗？”
狗系统弱弱道：【这是日常任务，它也不受我的控制呀……和铃，要不你还是去给夜弦打个招呼吧。】
【反正就一句话的事情，比你埋头苦修一两天效率高多了。】
“哼！”和铃冷哼一声。
content_en:
"Tribulation is the wrath of heaven and earth, the calamity of all living beings, and the test of the great road."
"The world avoids calamity as if it were death, but I regard calamity as food."
"Open your mouth and swallow it, enter your belly and transform it. The power of calamity will be mine, and the intention of calamity will be gone."
"Swallow one kalpa and gain wisdom; swallow ten thousand kalpas and prove my way. If the kalpas are not exhausted, I will never be destroyed..."
He Ling scratched his hair, with a look of shock and surprise on his face.
Is this a... skill?
Why did she suddenly have an extra skill in her mind?
"Xiao Yi, Gouzi, did you two secretly transmit anything to me that I shouldn't have?"
The dog system immediately said: [No, I am being honest now! 】
Xiao Yi asked tentatively: [A-Ling, what are you talking about? If you believe me, you can tell me and Xiaoyi can help you analyze it. 】
To be honest, I don’t trust either system or bell.
"Forget it, you two keep silent, I'll figure it out myself."
He Ling re-read the general outline of the exercise silently, expressing doubts in his heart.
Devour?
I can boast so much, but is it true?
If it were true, it would be too domineering, too strong, and too arrogant!
However, it fits her style very well.
A difficult choice was placed in front of He Ling.
Should she practice this "Swallowing Tribulation" or not?
The general outline of the exercises is written in such an arrogant and domineering way, it seems a bit evil at first glance!
Unfortunately, this technique appeared in her mind by herself, and she couldn't ask anyone.
Forget it, when she first came to this world, she had better keep a low profile and continue to practice the "Liang Yi Shui Jue" practiced by her original body.
There was nothing to do while he was idle, so He Ling began to practice according to his original memory.
An hour passed.
Two hours passed.
There is no effect at all.
[Ding—Today’s dog-licking mission has been released: greet the target Ye Xian. 】
[Reward: Stable Golden Pill, Cultivation +1. 】
He Ling was a little angry: "I'm practicing. If you give out tasks here, aren't you causing trouble?"
The dog system said weakly: [This is a daily task, and it is not under my control... He Ling, why don't you go say hello to Ye Xian. 】
[Anyway, just one sentence is much more efficient than studying hard for a day or two. 】
"Huh!" He Ling snorted coldly.
